en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a long, three‑storey brick institutional building with a slate mansard-style roof and many evenly spaced tall windows. Small dormer windows line the roof. The façade is symmetrical, with a central arched entrance on the right wing reached by steps and a gabled end section. There is a spire visible behind the roofline suggesting a chapel or nearby church. A low metal fence and a strip of landscaping run in front of the building, with an open grassy field in the foreground and a few distant buildings and trees to the right. No printed caption or handwritten text is visible on the image side.
